implementation.argument_surface: receiver in ECX, aliased into ESI at 0x00577315 and addressed through ESI on every access; exactly ONE ordinary stack argument, the word at entry_ESP+0x4, read at 0x005773e2 as `MOV EBX,[ESP+0x38]` with ESP at entry_ESP-0x34. implementation.return_type_reasoning: OPTION (b) OF THE TWO THE CONTRACT OFFERS, and explicitly chosen. The machine-derived record's return claim is the phrase `unclassified_in_EAX` and the persisted Ghidra record's is `undefined`; neither is a type, so no declared return type can equal the canonical token and RETURN SEMANTICS warns whichever way it is written. Declaring `void` is the honest reading of the listing and not a way to win the string comparison: the three paths that reach the epilogue at 0x005774e0 leave EAX holding three different incidental words -- the receiver's 0x308 member on the sentinel arm (0x005773c2, or 0x00577378 on the arm that skipped the cold block), the query's own AL on the false arm (0x0057742b), and the release's return on the tail arm (0x005774de). A body that returned a pointer on one arm, a byte on another and nothing on a third returns nothing. No typedef named after the machine phrase was created, and the model test asserts nothing about EAX.
implementation.receiver_model: a struct with NO members at all, reached only through the displacement accessors `word_at(self, kReceiverToolMemberDisplacement)` and `word_at(self, kReceiverTargetMemberDisplacement)`. abi_derived.receiver.bounds_only is true, so the record says where the body was seen reaching and not which member is which, and naming a member would declare an identity the machine does not fix. The run is 0x310 bytes, which is 0x30c plus one dword and therefore this package's lower bound, not a layout claim. The test fills a 0x320-byte probe with a pattern and asserts that only the eight bytes of those two words ever change.
implementation.dispatch_model: seven indirect transfers, all the same two-level shape, declared through one accessor `vtable_word_at(object, slot_displacement)` and three function-pointer types (AcquireSlot for slot +0x0, ReleaseSlot for slot +0x4, QuerySlot for slot +0x2c). The association with the table at 0x013f57f8 is recorded for the integrator and deliberately not modelled as a member access.
implementation.dependency_note: all five direct callees and all three dispatch shapes are declared extern in the package header and defined as observers in the package's own model test; no other package's header is included and nothing about any of them is asserted beyond what their own instruction bytes fix.

mechanics.body_shape: test the receiver's +0x308 word for null and, when it is null, build an 'Editor' object through a factory and an in-place constructor, swap it into the member, and register three 12-byte records on it; then, unless the caller's argument is the all-ones sentinel, clear that argument word in place, fetch a global object through a six-byte accessor, ask it a yes/no question through table slot +0x2c with the original argument as subject and the contents of the .data cell at 0x0150cdd4 as a weight, and on a yes build a second member object the same way, look an instance id up on the object the query answered with under the key 0x700ed5e1, and register that id as a fourth record on the second member; finally release the query's answer through table slot +0x4 when it is non-null

frame_resolution.method: one linear walk of ESP through all 147 instructions, using each callee's own RET immediate to settle the stack after every call. Entry ESP is 0 in the walk; the prologue takes it to -0x34 and the epilogue's three POPs plus ADD ESP,0x28 take it back to 0, and RET 0x4 then drops the one argument word.
frame_resolution.corroboration_argument_one: 0x005773e2 `MOV EBX,[ESP+0x38]` is reached from two paths: by fall-through from the third registration call, and by the JNZ at 0x0057731f, which arrives having pushed nothing but the three saved registers. For one instruction to read the same word on both paths, ESP must be the same on both, so the three PUSHes at 0x0057738c, 0x005773a6 and 0x005773cc must each have been undone by their own callee. That fixes ESP at entry_ESP-0x34 on both paths and puts [ESP+0x38] at entry_ESP+0x4, the caller's own argument word.
frame_resolution.corroboration_argument_two: 0x007b1e90's terminator is `C2 04 00` at 0x007b1f3b -- it pops its own single stack word. Its prologue is five pushes and its own 0x007b1ea7 `MOV EBX,[ESP+0x18]` therefore reads ITS entry_ESP+0x4, which is exactly the word this body pushed. The same callee's 0x007b1ead `MOV EDI,[EBX+0x8]` and 0x007b1eb4 `CMP EDI,0x40464100` read the THIRD word of the record this body wrote and compare it against the constant this body wrote, so the 12-byte size and the tail value are corroborated from another body's bytes rather than assumed.
frame_resolution.rejected_alternative: if the callees did not pop, the three records would overlap each other by one word, [ESP+0x38] at 0x005773e2 would read the third record's own tail word instead of the caller's argument, and the comparison at 0x005773e6 would be against a constant this body had just written rather than against the caller's value. The alternative is recorded because it is the natural first guess on a body with three unpopped pushes, not because it survives 0x007b1f3b.

slots.entry-0x28 / base+0x0c: the instance-id lookup's out word. Zeroed at 0x00577495 after the three pushes and before the call; read back at 0x005774a2 and its non-zeroness is the branch at 0x005774ab; its first word becomes the fourth record's id.
slots.entry-0xc / base+0x28: registration record three (0x7d708f46, 0x510a95b, 0x40464100), later OVERWRITTEN IN PLACE by registration record four
the three saved registers, pushed at 0x00577313..0x0057731e and popped at 0x005774e0..0x005774e2. Never addressed by any other instruction.
slots.entry-0x28 + 0 .. +0xb / base+0x0c .. +0: the low half of the reserved frame is the lookup's out word followed by record one and record two; the whole reserved range is entry-0x28..entry-0x1 and every byte of it is written before it is read

frame_resolution.fourth_record_aliases_third: 0x005773c8 `LEA EDX,[ESP+0x28]` and 0x005774b7 `LEA EAX,[ESP+0x28]` are the same instruction with the same displacement, at the same stack depth (both are reached with ESP at the base). The fourth registration therefore writes over the third record's three words. The model keeps ONE frame array and ONE displacement constant for both, and the model test compares the two addresses the callee actually receives, so a reconstruction that gave the fourth record its own storage is refuted rather than merely argued about.

receiver_displacement.0x308: read at 0x00577317 as the cold-start guard (`CMP DWORD PTR [ESI+0x308],0x0`), captured as the old member at 0x0057734f, written at 0x00577365, and re-read as the receiver of the three registration calls at 0x00577378, 0x005773a7 and 0x005773c2. Four reads and one write.
receiver_displacement.0x30c: captured as the old member at 0x0057745d, written at 0x00577473, and re-read as the receiver of the fourth registration at 0x005774ad. Never used as a guard. It is the same shape as 0x308, one swap later, and nothing in this body says why the two differ in that one respect.
receiver_displacement.why_no_members_are_named: abi_derived.receiver is bounds_only with offsets [776, 780] and no further information. Naming a member would assert which of the two is which and what either is; the record supports neither. The model reaches both through accessors with the displacements as named constants, so a wrong displacement lands somewhere the test planted a decoy rather than looking like a plausible field write.

layout_derivation.note: these offsets are read off the DIRECT CALLEES' own instruction bytes in the same image, not off this body's displacement list, and each is cited so a reviewer can check it against the instruction that fixes it.
layout_derivation.record is 12 bytes: 0x007b1e90 reads its stack word into EBX at 0x007b1ea7, dereferences EBX+0x00 at 0x007b1ef1 and EBX+0x08 at 0x007b1ead, and pushes the first as a call argument at 0x007b1efc. It never reads past +0x08, and this body never writes past +0x08, so twelve bytes is fixed from both ends.
layout_derivation.record tail value: 0x007b1eb4 `CMP EDI,0x40464100` against the word at the record's +0x08, with 0x007b1ebc replacing it with 0x40464200 when equal. This body writes 0x40464100 at that displacement on all four registrations, so the callee takes its substitution branch every time. That 0x40464200 is a constant of the callee, not of this body, and nothing here claims what it means.
layout_derivation.record middle word: NOT corroborated. 0x007b1e90 never reads the record's +0x04, so the 0x510a95b this body writes there is modelled as an opaque word and no claim is made about it.
layout_derivation.factory's six words: 0x00f473a0 reads [ESP+0x8], [ESP+0x10], [ESP+0x14] and [ESP+0x18] in its first four instructions and tail-calls 0x009289f0 with five words of its own; it does not read [ESP+0x4] or [ESP+0xc] there. This body drops 0x18 = 6*4 itself, so the argument count is six. What 0x34 is -- a size, a count, a flags word -- is not fixed by any body read here and is not claimed.
layout_derivation.lookup's three words: 0x006a12a0 reads [ESP+0x4] as the object and writes the instance id through [ESP+0xc] at 0x006a12cf, with the stack already balanced by the inner __thiscall at 0x006a12b7, so its third argument is the out-pointer this body pre-zeroes. It also passes its own second argument and the address of its first argument to that inner call. Its first argument is tested for null at 0x006a12a4 and the whole function returns false when it is null, which is why a null query answer makes the lookup a no-op even on the yes arm.

mechanics.control_flow: ten conditional branches, all with absolute targets inside the recovered body span 0x00577310..0x005774e8: JNZ 0x005773e2 (0x0057731f), JZ 0x0057734d (0x0057733e), JZ 0x00577378 (0x00577357), JZ 0x00577365 (0x0057735b), JZ 0x00577378 (0x0057736d), JZ 0x00577415 (0x005773e9 -- the sentinel, to the epilogue), JZ 0x00577415 (0x00577404, always taken), JZ 0x005774d1 (0x0057742d -- the query's bool), JZ 0x00577486 (0x0057744c), JZ 0x00577486 (0x00577465), JZ 0x00577486 (0x00577469), JZ 0x00577473 (0x0057746b and 0x0057747b), JZ 0x005774d1 (0x005774ab -- the out word), JZ 0x005774e0 (0x005774d7), plus two intra-procedural unconditional jumps at 0x0057734b and 0x00577459. Every one is reproduced, including the always-taken JZ at 0x00577404 and the guarded release it skips.
mechanics.unreachable_block: 0x00577406..0x00577413 (a second store of zero over the argument word followed by a release through slot +0x4 of the value ECX held at 0x005773fc) is reproduced as a real conditional in the model, with the reason it can never be entered stated at the site. It is not deleted: deleting it would hide a fact a reader of the bytes can check, and keeping it lets the model test prove it is never taken by observing that exactly one release of the handle happens in a whole call. 0x007b1e90 contains the same idiom in the same order (0x007b1ec1, 0x007b1ec9, 0x007b1ed1, 0x007b1ed6, 0x007b1edc, 0x007b1ede, 0x007b1ee0, 0x007b1eed), which corroborates that it is the compiler's shape and not a misread of this body's bytes.
mechanics.globals: two, and the check cannot corroborate either. 0x0150cdd4 is named by this body at 0x00577415 and holds 0x3f800000 in the committed image; 0x013eb430 is named by this body at 0x0057732d and 0x0057743b and is the ASCII string "Editor". A third address, 0x015fd8a8, is named by 0x0067de30's own two instructions rather than by this body, and the model reaches it only through that callee's observer. The xref export carries no data-reference edge type, so GLOBALS warns on the listing's two data addresses no matter what the source says. The source span names NEITHER, deliberately: a hex literal in the span is fed to the CONSTANTS and GLOBALS arms, and the model refers to both through named constants declared in the header, which is outside the span.

direct_call_1.return: a pointer tested for null at 0x0057733c / 0x0057744a; when non-null it becomes the receiver of 0x007b07e0 and the model discards the factory's own semantics entirely

direct_call_2.arguments: ECX = the factory's return, one stack word 0xffffffff (printed `PUSH -0x1`)
direct_call_2.return: EAX, and its own 0x007b0852 `MOV EAX,ESI` shows it returns its receiver. The model relies on that: the constructed object is the factory's pointer. If a real 0x007b07e0 ever returned something else, the model's member value would differ -- which is a statement about this package's fixture, not about the original.

direct_call_3.at: 0x0057739d, 0x005773bd and 0x005773dd on the receiver's 0x308 member, and 0x005774cc on its 0x30c member
direct_call_3.convention: __thiscall -- `C2 04 00` at 0x007b1f3b, which is also what settles this body's frame
direct_call_3.arguments: ECX = the member word re-read from the frame at 0x00577378 / 0x005773a7 / 0x005773c2 / 0x005774ad, and one stack word: the ADDRESS of a 12-byte record at base+0x10, +0x1c, +0x28 and +0x28 respectively
direct_call_3.return: declared void, and deliberately so: this body never reads EAX after any of the four calls, and inside the callee EAX holds whatever its last internal call left (the 0x007b1eff result's AL possibly clobbered by the 0x007b1f11 call and by the release at 0x007b1f2b). No byte establishes a return value, so declaring one would be an invention. This body also does NOT release the member it passes; the callee's own 0x007b1f22..0x007b1f2b releases the receiver it was given, which is a fact about the callee and is not modelled.
direct_call_3.callee_record: no metadata sidecar for this address; its 173-byte body was read from the image

direct_call_4.convention: cdecl with NO argument at all: the whole body is `A1 A8 D8 5F 01 C3`, i.e. MOV EAX,DWORD PTR DS:0x015fd8a8 / RET
direct_call_4.arguments: none in any register and none on the stack. ECX still holds the receiver's 0x308 member at this point and the callee ignores it.
direct_call_4.return: the contents of the .data cell at 0x015fd8a8, which the committed image holds as zero because it is filled by start-up code that is not in this repository. The model obtains it from the observer and claims nothing about its value.
direct_call_4.why_it_matters_twice: it is what makes the block at 0x00577406..0x00577413 unreachable, because a six-byte callee that reads one absolute cell cannot write the caller's frame. It is also why the query that follows reads a real object: the value it returns is dereferenced as an object with a table at 0x0057741b.

direct_call_5.convention: cdecl -- bare `RET` at 0x006a12da, and the body drops the three words at 0x005774a6
direct_call_5.arguments: three words pushed right to left, so the order is (subject, 0x700ed5e1, &out). The subject is the query's answer read back out of the argument word at 0x00577486. The out word is the frame word at base+0x0c, and the callee writes it at 0x006a12cf.
direct_call_5.return: a bool in AL, and THIS BODY DISCARDS IT: 0x005774a2 overwrites EAX from the out word before 0x005774a9 tests anything. The model discards it too, and the model test drives the callee to return false while writing a non-zero word and to return true while writing zero, so a reconstruction that branched on the bool is refuted in both directions.
direct_call_5.callee_record: no metadata sidecar for this address; its 59-byte body was read from the image

mechanics.receiver_writes: two dword stores, one at each of 0x308 and 0x30c, and each is inside a swap that is skipped when the replacement equals the member. unresolved_questions: What the receiver's two members ARE is not established. 0x308 is guarded for null and carries three registrations; 0x30c is unguarded and carries one, only on a yes answer. Nothing read here says what either points at, and the record is bounds_only so no member may be named. Whether they are the same kind of object that the factory happens to return, and whether the +0x308 guard is a deliberate one-shot initialisation or an accident of a template, is not settled.

Why the second member is not guarded the way the first is. The two swaps are byte-for-byte the same sequence apart from the displacement, yet the first is entered on a null test and the second is entered on the query's answer. Something outside this body must decide whether the second swap is ever needed twice; nothing in this body does.

What the three record ids 0x8104e4b0, 0x9d1fcc2f and 0x7d708f46 are. They are 32-bit hashed strings, the standard shape for this binary's property vocabulary, and the factory is handed the class name "Editor" -- but no record in this repository maps any of the three to a name, and the preimages were not searched for.

What the record's middle word, 0x510a95b, is for. It is written on all four registrations and 0x007b1e90 never reads it, so it is consumed by something further downstream (0x007b1e90's own follow-up call at 0x007b1f11 to 0x007b1de0 receives the same record pointer and is the obvious candidate) that was not read here. The model treats it as opaque and claims nothing.

Whether the query's second argument is meant as a float. The cell at 0x0150cdd4 holds 0x3f800000, which is exactly the IEEE-754 single 1.0f, and 0x007b1e90's own record handling compares a record word against a value in the same neighbourhood. That is suggestive and is NOT a claim: nothing read here declares the parameter's type, and the model forwards the word as a word.

The block at 0x00577406..0x00577413 is dead in this body and this record explains why, but WHY the compiler emitted it is not settled. 0x007b1e90 contains the identical idiom in the identical order, which makes it a template artefact rather than a mistake; whether some sibling in the table at 0x013f57f8 reaches it is not known, because none of those bodies was read.

Whether the return value is genuinely void. The decompiler says void, the persisted Ghidra record says undefined, and the machine-derived record says unclassified_in_EAX. This package declares void on the strength of the three inconsistent EAX values at the three epilogue entries, and that inference is a reading of the listing rather than a record. A caller that consumed the EAX word would make the reconstruction wrong, and no caller is named by any record for this VA.

No direct caller of this body is named anywhere. Its only reference in the binary is the data word at 0x013f5840, so the argument at entry_ESP+0x4 and the 0xffffffff sentinel are fixed by the body's own comparison and by nothing that calls it. What the sentinel means to the caller -- "no subject", "destroy", "reset" -- is not established.

The five direct callees and the three dispatch shapes are all defined in the test as observers that record every argument, the address of every record pointer, and the state of memory at the moment of the transfer. The ABI is measured by sampling ESP before and after every call, equal only if the frame balances.

mutation_checking.known_limits: The 0x0150cdd4 cell is modelled as a package-scope word, so a defect in WHICH cell is read cannot be caught by the test -- only a defect in forwarding what it holds can. The `vtable_word_at` slot displacements are checked by faulting rather than by assertion: a wrong displacement lands on a decoy word and the process dies, which kills the build but is a coarser signal than a named failure.
